resources.string: A little care, one small session.
Make room for a small reset
Choose a few starter ideas for the kitchen, bathroom, bedroom and living room, or begin with your own tasks. Every idea can be changed or removed.
Your rooms, tasks and journal stay on this device. No account is needed.
How much time do you have?
Choose a limit. You will see the tasks and their reasons before starting.
Saved session: %1$d of %2$d marked done · %3$d-minute limit
Add a room and a few tasks, then choose a time limit.
No rooms yet. You can still keep tasks without a room.
The tasks will stay in My tasks without a room. Completion journal entries will stay as they were.
This date controls the next due day. Editing it does not add a journal entry.
No tasks yet. Add a small task you would like to do regularly.
Due includes today and tasks with no previous date. Soon means the next two days.
Pending session items will be removed. Completed journal entries will stay; an active session can still undo its completion.
A pending session item may leave the session if its new date or duration no longer fits. Completed items keep their recorded details.
Enter a whole number from 1 to 480.
Enter a whole number from 1 to 3650.
Could not save the change. Your previous data are kept. Please try again.
Could not read your saved tasks. Your data have been kept on this device.
You can retry opening your schedule or start an empty one. Before any replacement, the original files will be copied and checked on this device.

Your current rooms, tasks, and history will not appear in the new schedule. Their original files will remain in a separate recovery copy on this device. Nothing will be replaced if the copy cannot be verified.
Could not complete the fresh start. Your original data remain on this device, including any recovery copy already created. Free some storage and try again.
Tasks without a previous date come first. Other due tasks are ordered by their age relative to their repeat interval and their priority. Each next task must fit the time left.
This suggestion changes no completion dates. Only your explicit done marks create journal entries.
%1$d min · Longer than the chosen time limit
%1$d min · Does not fit the time left
%1$d min · Edited; no longer due or no longer fits
Your tasks are still fresh, or your list is empty. Add a task or review its previous date and repeat interval.
The due tasks need more time
No task fits this limit. Choose a longer session or split a large task into smaller tasks.
Continue it, or close it before choosing a new suggestion. Done marks remain in the journal.
Mark each task only after you complete it. You can pause and return after closing the app.
There are no pending items left after your task changes. Close this session and choose a new one.
Only marked tasks have been recorded. Unmarked tasks keep their previous dates.
Done marks stay in the journal. Unmarked tasks keep their previous dates. You can choose a new session afterwards.
Your journal is empty. Complete a task during a session to record it here.
Each entry records an explicit done mark, with the room and task name from that moment.
